newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar exports up 7 pct at $5.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar exports up 7 pct at $5.5 bln.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Friday that its exports set a new company record in 1996, up seven percent from 1995 at $5.50 billion.

"The continued growth in our exports is an important measure of our success in maintaining our position as a leading global company from a principally U.S. manufacturing base," Donald Fites, Caterpillar chairman and chief executive, said in the company's annual report.
Sales of Caterpillar products were up in all regions except Europe and Canada. In Europe sales fell 11.9 percent to $2.37 billion and in Canada 13.9 percent to $820 million.

The largest sales increase was posted in Africa and the Middle East, where Caterpillar posted a 25.9 percent rise to $1.15 billion. In Asia sales rose 11.8 percent to $2.56 billion, and in Latin America 4.6 percent to $1.24 billion.
Caterpillar sales in the United States rose 3.4 percent to $7.67 billion.
